notes: Merged in https://github.com/seanburkes/playnite-linux/pull/96 at f12a4325c58cf66d47b93c5768e46861696d3052, ancestor of main 0ecee26. The merged contract stores referenced Game/Platform assets at <database>.assets/sha256/<first-two-hex>/<64-lowercase-hex>, keyed only by streaming SHA-256 so identical bytes deduplicate across filenames; publication is a verified CreateNew .tmp then no-overwrite rename, an existing hash-named blob is rehashed and never rewritten, and a real SIGKILL mid-copy leaves only a temporary file that a retry completes. PNG IHDR, GIF logical-screen and JPEG SOF dimensions are read from a bounded header without any pixel decoder; unsupported and invalid-header formats are still copied with explicit status. Per-reference copied/reused/planned/missing/unreadable/empty/external outcomes are reported with record identity and path, SQLite image fields carry explicit playnite-asset markers for non-path outcomes, unreadable reader snapshots stay reported after their lock clears, and source bytes/legacy documents are unchanged. Evidence: tests/fixtures/v10-assets with recorded provenance and two byte-exact frozen-v10 PNG copies, AssetCopyTests cases including V10_assets_are_copied_with_header_dimensions_and_missing_reference_is_counted_by_identity, SIGKILL_mid_copy_leaves_only_a_temporary_file_then_retry_publishes_verified_blob, Platform_image_fields_are_remapped_and_original_documents_are_retained and the seeded malformed-header fuzz check.
